title: T20-S v2: geometry knob with a fixed spectrum, valid optimality-gap intervals, paired learner contrasts on a fixed N grid with simultaneous inference, and pilot-frozen scaling-model selection

provenance.design_input: experiments/mlst2026/successor_20260912/t20s/PROTOCOL_T20S.json (schema mlst-successor-protocol/1, frozen 2026-09-12T00:35:00Z; immutable design input, not launch-ready)
archived_code_reused_by_import_unchanged: experiments/paper1/t20_population_accounting.py: als_population (population ALS with HOSVD + random restarts), risk (R_K(P) = tr K - tr(B^T K B))
experiments/synthetic/nfpa_confirmatory/methods.py: als_fit (data ALS, training-loss restart selection, collect_restarts)
experiments/synthetic/nfpa_confirmatory/generator.py: kron_basis (Fortran vec index c + C t)
corrected_relative_to_design_input: grid: 'inside 800-1600' replaced by a fixed, fully enumerated grid theta x N x seed (see design.grid); anchors 400 and 3200 are declared now
seed allocation: seeds no longer stand for fits; every cell is enumerated with its fit count (1 PCA + R ALS restarts) and solve count; pilot and confirmation seed namespaces are disjoint and declared

replication and simultaneous inference: independent unit, per-theta max-|t| bootstrap over seeds across the N grid with a Bonferroni-t fallback, sign profile and adjacent brackets are declared before sampling

scaling-model selection: a concrete pilot-only algorithm (two-fold out-of-sample comparison on deterministic seed halves) writes FROZEN_SELECTION.json before any confirmation cell exists; the confirmation runner refuses to draw confirmation cells without it
generator: an analytic K(theta) with a specified spectrum replaces the Monte-Carlo pulse-family covariance proxy; its invariants are verified and recorded before fitting

risk accounting vocabulary: a is reported as an interval [lower bound, best-found]; x_F is reference-relative (may be negative); 'excess risk' replaces 'estimation excess'; restart agreement is never a certificate
budget: the expired 400-fit mission allocation is not carried over; the cap is computed from the enumerated matrix and measured timings
stopping rule: fixed allocation (all enumerated cells), no outcome-dependent stop
historical_verdicts_that_stand: registered c/N law for x_U refuted on the archived pulse-family proxy (T20 stage B)
N* ~ 960 is a log-linear interpolation of stage-B means, exploratory only
sign reversal of d between N = 800 and N = 1600 on fresh seeds (T20 stage C) for the archived pulse-family proxy and the implemented learners
the analytic generator of this package does NOT certify the archived Monte-Carlo proxy; it is a new synthetic family

question: On an analytic Gaussian family whose whitened clean-signal second moment K(theta) has a FIXED spectrum and a geometry knob theta that moves the top-k eigenspace off the product class: how does the paired class contrast d(N) = R_K(P_F_hat) - R_K(P_U_hat) behave over a fixed N grid, how large is the valid optimality-gap interval for the approximation cost a, and does any declared scaling model, selected on pilot seeds only, predict fresh-seed confirmation cells?
hypotheses: H1 (control, exact): at theta = 0 the top-k eigenspace is a product subspace by construction, so the partial-trace lower bound is 0 and the best-found population a is 0 to 1e-8.

H2 (invariants, exact): for every theta in the grid the eigenvalues of K(theta) equal mu to 1e-10, and trace, rank, SNR and Delta_k are unchanged, while k - cap(theta) and the interval [Delta_k (k - cap), a_best] change with theta.

H3 (descriptive, scored by simultaneous CI on confirmation seeds): the sign profile of d(N) over the grid within each theta > 0; the design predicts, from population quantities and first-order theory only, a profile with a bracket above the core grid for theta_1, inside the core grid for theta_2 and below it for theta_3. The profile is reported as observed, nonmonotone if so; no crossing is interpolated.

H4 (scaling, pilot-frozen): at most one of {none, c/N, c/N^alpha, c/N + d/N^2} is selected for x_U(N) and at most one for d(N) - a_ref(theta) on pilot seeds; its frozen per-theta predictions are scored against the confirmation simultaneous band at every grid N. If the frozen choice is 'none', confirmation reports only the bracket/profile.
independent_unit: one replicate seed. A seed indexes one replicate across all (theta, N) cells of its phase; within a seed, the datasets of different (theta, N) cells are independent draws from disjoint substreams, and within a cell BOTH learners see the same z_i (paired). Inference resamples seeds, jointly across the N grid within each theta.

estimands.R_K(P): tr K - tr(P K), the exact population risk of a rank-k orthogonal projector under K(theta) (units: whitened variance).
estimands.R_U_star: R_K(P*_U), P*_U = top-k eigenprojector of K (closed form).
estimands.a_lower: Delta_k (k - cap(theta)), cap = min{k, sum_{i<=k_c} lambda_i(M_c), sum_{i<=k_t} lambda_i(M_t)} with M_c, M_t the partial traces of P*_U (MLST Prop 3.6 lower bound; valid for EVERY product projector).
estimands.a_best: R_K(P_F^best) - R_U_star with P_F^best the best of (R_pop + 1) population-ALS restarts on K (HOSVD + R_pop random); an UPPER bound on a = R_K(P*_F) - R_U_star. a is reported as the interval [a_lower, a_best]; restart agreement is not a certificate.
estimands.x_U: R_K(P_U_hat) - R_U_star, excess risk of top-k PCA of the centred sample second moment; exact and >= 0.
estimands.x_F_ref: R_K(P_F_hat) - R_K(P_F^best), reference-relative excess risk of the training-loss-selected separable ALS fit; contains estimation AND optimization error; may be negative because the reference is best-found, not certified.
estimands.d: R_K(P_F_hat) - R_K(P_U_hat), the paired class contrast. Identity: d = a_best + x_F_ref - x_U exactly (residual recorded).
estimands.restart_spread_risk: max - min over the R restarts of R_K of the restart's product projector; when >= |d| in a cell, that cell is flagged as unresolved between sampling and optimization error.
estimands.selection_matches_population_best: whether the training-loss-selected restart is also the restart with the smallest population risk (diagnostic; selection is never by population risk).

controls: theta0_a_zero: theta = 0 cells; a_lower must be exactly 0 and a_best <= 1e-8 (H1); d(N) at theta = 0 is reported (expected <= 0 in mean, not asserted)
spectrum_fixed: every algebraic cell records max |eig(K(theta)) - mu| and requires <= 1e-10

nonseparability_moves: k - cap(theta) pairwise distinct across the theta grid (tolerance 1e-6); a theta that fails any invariant is recorded as excluded and dropped from inference, never re-tuned on outcomes
bound_order: a_lower <= a_best in every theta (a violation is a code defect and is rejected)
identity: |d - (a_best + x_F_ref - x_U)| <= 1e-9 in every fit cell
x_U_nonnegative: x_U >= -1e-9 in every fit cell
training_loss_selection: the selected restart equals argmin of the recorded restart training losses in every fit cell
reference_consistency: the reference quantities recorded in a fit cell equal those of the algebraic cell of the same theta to 1e-9

design.family: analytic Gaussian: z = s + n, s ~ N(0, K(theta)), n ~ N(0, I) in whitened coordinates; K(theta) = V(theta) diag(mu) V(theta)^T, V(theta) = V_sep expm(theta A). NEW family, distinct from the historical pulse-family population (T14/T20).

spectrum.note: mu_1..mu_6 as listed; Delta_6 = 4; geometric tail from 3.0 to 0.02 over 250 entries; tr K = 206.604 (snr_per_coordinate = tr K / d = 0.807; noise covariance I)

production.theta_choice: chosen before sampling from POPULATION quantities only: the interval [a_lower, a_best] at each theta and the first-order PCA constant c_U = sum_{i<=k, j>k} (mu_i+1)(mu_j+1)/(mu_i - mu_j) = 3010 give predicted upper bounds c_U / a_best on the crossing of ~5600 (theta = 0.12), ~1300 (0.25) and ~520 (0.40), i.e. above, inside and below the core grid. Development-namespace probes (3 seeds at theta = 0.15 with R = 8; 1 seed at theta = 0.25 with R = 4) were run for timing and confirmed the first-order c_U (x_U(800) = 3.6-3.9 vs 3.76); development draws are never citable and no pilot or confirmation seed was drawn.

population_intervals_recorded_at_design.note: 3-decimal record of the algebraic quantities (solves, no data) the algebraic cells recompute and check

design.restart_selection: training loss only (als_fit); every restart's training loss and population risk are recorded

fixture.note: development namespace only; outputs are development_only and never citable

inference.rule: per theta, max-|t| (studentized) bootstrap over seeds jointly across the N grid, 2000 replicates, fixed seed; simultaneous 95% band m_N +/- q SE_N; a Bonferroni-t band (alpha / (2 n_N), n - 1 df) is computed alongside and becomes the reported band only when fewer than half of the bootstrap replicates are valid (documented fallback)
inference.min_seeds_note: below 8 seeds per theta the studentized bootstrap is degenerate (with n = 2 the only non-degenerate resample is the sample itself and q = 0); the Bonferroni-t band is then the reported band; production has 16 pilot and 24 confirmation seeds, the fixture always uses the fallback
inference.profile: per-N sign decided by the simultaneous band (+, -, 0 undetermined); adjacent brackets are pairs of adjacent grid N with decided opposite signs; nonmonotone profiles are reported as such; an interpolated crossing is never a measurement

scaling_selection.algorithm: pilot seeds sorted; first half = fitting seeds, second half = holdout (deterministic); each candidate is fitted by least squares to the per-N means of the fitting half and scored by mean squared prediction error on the per-seed values of the holdout half; the two folds (A->B, B->A) are summed over all theta; the parametric candidate with the smallest error is selected only if it beats 'none' strictly; at most one model per target
scaling_selection.freeze: the pilot reducer writes FROZEN_SELECTION.json (selection, parameters refitted on all pilot seeds per theta, predictions at the grid, pilot cell digest, protocol sha) into the run root before any confirmation cell exists; the confirmation runner refuses to draw confirmation cells unless the file exists in the same run root; the confirmation reducer refuses if the file is missing or the pilot digest changed
scaling_selection.scoring: frozen predictions are scored inside/outside the confirmation simultaneous band at every grid N per theta; 'supported at the grid' iff inside at every N; if the frozen choice is 'none', confirmation reports only the bracket/profile

inference.sampling_vs_optimization: a fit cell with restart_spread_risk >= |d| is flagged; a (theta, N) cell with more than half of its seeds flagged is reported as unresolved between sampling and optimization error

stopping_rule: fixed allocation: all enumerated cells of the pilot phase, then the pilot reduce (freeze), then all enumerated cells of the confirmation phase, then the confirmation reduce; no early stop, no outcome-dependent extension

failure_interpretation.theta_invariant_failure: the theta is recorded as excluded in the algebraic cell and dropped from selection, scoring and profiles; the remaining thetas stand; the generator is not re-tuned
failure_interpretation.frozen_none: no scaling model is tested; confirmation reports brackets and profiles only; this is a reportable outcome
failure_interpretation.prediction_outside_band: the frozen model is not supported at the grid for that theta; a partial pattern (inside at some N) is reported as such, not as partial support
failure_interpretation.unresolved_cells: where restart spread is of the order of the contrast the package cannot separate sampling from optimization error; such cells are flagged and excluded from any mechanism statement
failure_interpretation.no_decided_signs: if the simultaneous band contains 0 at every N for a theta, the profile is undetermined and no bracket is claimed
failure_interpretation.failed_or_retried_cells: charged in the ledger and never refunded; a cell missing at reduce refuses the reduce (exit 3) unless --allow-partial, which labels the output partial

budget.fits_note: one fit = one estimator invocation on drawn data: 1 closed-form PCA + R = 4 ALS restarts per fit cell; population references (eigendecomposition, R_pop + 1 population-ALS solves, bound) are solves charged to the algebraic cell of each theta and recomputed deterministically (cached per process) where a fit cell needs them
budget.retry_policy: 600 fits of headroom under the cap = 120 whole-cell retries (12.5%); failures and interrupts are charged at start and never refunded; a retry is a new attempt

fixture_to_production_scale.derivation: measured locally on one development seed with the package's own run_fit_cell (single BLAS thread, R = 4): 2.24, 4.20, 4.85, 7.04, 8.55, 17.82 s at N = 400, 800, 1000, 1250, 1600, 3200 (mean 7.45 s per fit cell over the grid; linear in N); the fixture fit cell (d = 12, N in {40, 80}, R = 2) measures 0.0165 s, ratio 450. One production algebraic cell (all four thetas, cold cache) measures 2.3 s against 0.005 s for the fixture, ratio ~450. Point estimates without variance; the estimate subcommand multiplies the fixture timings observed in a run root by these factors. Production point estimate: 960 fit cells x 7.45 s + 4 x 2.3 s = ~7200 CPU-seconds (~2.0 CPU-hours) single-threaded; embarrassingly parallel over cells with one worker per ledger (see REMOTE_COMMANDS.md).

explicitly_not_claimed: a certified restricted population optimum P*_F (best-found values are upper bounds only)
universality of any scaling law beyond this analytic family and these learners
anything about the archived Monte-Carlo pulse-family proxy: the historical c/N refutation, the 960 interpolation and the 800/1600 sign reversal stand and are neither confirmed nor revised here
separation of sampling from optimization error in cells where restart spread is of the order of the contrast
any scientific result from fixture (development namespace) runs
